invariants.invariant: Confirmed open quantity must never be negative.
invariants.financial_risk_prevented: prevents impossible short accounting and over-close projections
invariants.failure_behavior: quarantine position cycle and reject dependent intents

invariants.invariant: Remaining quantity must never be negative after exit fills.
invariants.financial_risk_prevented: prevents over-exit and accidental reverse exposure
invariants.failure_behavior: quarantine position cycle and require reconciliation

invariants.invariant: Exited quantity cannot exceed confirmed filled entry quantity unless reconciliation correction explicitly proves broker truth.
invariants.financial_risk_prevented: prevents local state from closing more quantity than exists
invariants.failure_behavior: block new exits for the cycle until reconciled

invariants.invariant: Active protection quantity cannot exceed confirmed remaining quantity unless broker-proven OCO semantics are recorded.
invariants.financial_risk_prevented: prevents over-protection and accidental reverse orders
invariants.failure_behavior: reject protection intent and flag protection missing

invariants.invariant: No protection may be placed for unfilled entry quantity.
invariants.financial_risk_prevented: prevents naked exit orders before exposure exists

invariants.invariant: Protection generation numbers must increase monotonically per position cycle and protection type.
invariants.financial_risk_prevented: prevents stale replacement events from overwriting active protection
invariants.enforcement_point: replacement requirement creation and event replay
invariants.failure_behavior: ignore stale event, preserve newer generation, emit rejected transition evidence

invariants.invariant: Exactly one OrderStateMachine owns each ClientOrderIdentity.
invariants.financial_risk_prevented: prevents duplicate submits, duplicate cancels, and conflicting order state
invariants.failure_behavior: reject duplicate owner and quarantine order stream

invariants.invariant: Duplicate submit, acknowledge, cancel, replace, and fill events must be idempotent by identity and event sequence.
invariants.financial_risk_prevented: prevents double counting fills or repeated cancellations
invariants.failure_behavior: record duplicate as ignored evidence without state mutation

invariants.invariant: Fill after cancel request must be reconciled and projected; it must not be discarded because cancel was requested.
invariants.financial_risk_prevented: prevents hidden exposure after late broker fills
invariants.failure_behavior: project fill, update position, require reconciliation if broker state is unclear

invariants.invariant: Closed position cycles cannot accept new protection or fresh-entry mutation.
invariants.financial_risk_prevented: prevents reopening closed trades through stale lifecycle events
invariants.failure_behavior: reject requirement and preserve closed state

invariants.invariant: Fresh-entry requirements cannot mutate a carried-position cycle unless an authoritative re-entry rule explicitly permits it.
invariants.financial_risk_prevented: prevents mixing fresh and carried lifecycle exposure
invariants.failure_behavior: create a new cycle or reject with RULE_AUTHORITY_UNRESOLVED

invariants.invariant: Orders, fills, and positions from one account must not mutate another account.
invariants.failure_behavior: reject cross-account event and halt affected account session

invariants.invariant: Local order or position truth cannot override broker or paper truth after reconciliation proves a mismatch.
invariants.financial_risk_prevented: prevents acting on stale local projections
invariants.failure_behavior: block affected account or position cycle until reconciled

invariants.invariant: A failure must be isolated to the smallest safe owner unless portfolio control evidence explicitly escalates scope.
invariants.financial_risk_prevented: prevents unnecessary global shutdowns and prevents hidden broad failures
invariants.failure_behavior: block affected intent/order/position/account or global portfolio according to evidence

invariants.invariant: No intent may advance beyond offline evidence unless the requested authority mode is explicitly approved.
invariants.financial_risk_prevented: prevents accidental paper or live order activation

invariants.invariant: Analytics facts are downstream projections and cannot mutate orders, fills, positions, or account sessions.
invariants.financial_risk_prevented: prevents reports or dashboards from becoming hidden trading authority
invariants.failure_behavior: reject attempted reverse dependency in architecture tests
